subject: Read-only first header review: clump/cube/ETC2 blockers and compare correction
body: Read current workers/textures/nord2_texture_resources.h draft; no build/edit. Important fixes before promotion: 1) n2t_format_query initializes clump=0 and leaves it0 for ALL uncompressed formats; plane packing uses f.clump_format directly, so BGRA8 emits RAW8 instead ofRAW32,RGBA16F RAW8 instead ofRAW64. Derive RAW8/16/32/64/128 from bytes_per_block exactly as v9.xml687-692. 2) n2t_layout_check requires layers==1 for Cube kind5 because !is_array, then requires layers%6==0, so every ordinary cube refuses; allow exact6 and require square width==height. 3) ETC2 RGB8 and RGB8A1 cases180..183 incorrectly bpp16; pinned util/format/u_format.yaml997-1026 says X64=8bytes/block for these; RGBA8 is16. 4) first_layer is currently validated but never added to subresource addresses; clarify whether level.offset already incorporates viewbase (then document and test), otherwise add first_layer*stride. Also first_level physical metadata must agree offsets/base dimensions. Finally CORRECTION to my earlier compare wording: pinned panvk_vX_sampler.c58-64 returns MALI_FUNC_NEVER, not ALWAYS, for compareEnable=false. Your draft compare_enabled false=>0 is correct; retain the per-use field. Please use independent generated pack oracle tests incl BGRA8/RGBA16F byte-identity and cube positive tests.
